name: Crimson Sands Server Revival
description: Preservation and server revival for Dark Sun Online: Crimson Sands (SSI, 1996), a TEN-exclusive graphical MMO. Depends on ten-revival for the TEN protocol layer; this repo owns DSO-specific services, formats, and the unmodified Win95 client path. Phases 1–4 complete; next is EXP-001 first packet capture.
